title: Brandywine Racquet Club

services.name: Tennis Parties
services.desc: Brandywine Racquet Club is a first class tennis club in Delaware County. Whether you are a beginner or advanced tennis player, we provide a relaxing and fun atmosphere to play tennis, meet new friends and stay fit. Brandywine Racquet Club features six, well lit Dynaturf indoor tennis courts complete with male & female locker rooms, lounge area's and showers. Our main area features arelaxing viewing area perfect for winding down after a grueling match or just to relax and

blurb: Brandywine Racquet Club opened it's doors in 1970 with the simple objective of providing Delaware and Chester County with a 1st class, indoor tennis facility. Over the past 56 years we have worked hard to achieve this goal and are considered by many to be one of the premier clubs in the region.
